name: solend
docs: Simplified (non-Anchor) IDL for the Solend lending program.
Solend instructions are encoded as a single-byte discriminant (the
instruction enum index from solend-program instruction.rs) followed by
little-endian fields. The 'discriminant' and 'args' entries below only
document that encoding: the dict-form IDL path of
SolanaProgram.create_instruction passes pre-encoded data through
unchanged, and blockchainpype/solana/dapp/money_market/solend.py is the
authoritative builder for data bytes and account metas.
The 'deposit' entry maps to
DepositReserveLiquidityAndObligationCollateral (discriminant 14, args:
liquidityAmount u64) with accounts: sourceLiquidity(w),
destinationCollateral(w), reserve(w), reserveLiquiditySupply(w),
reserveCollateralMint(w), lendingMarket, lendingMarketAuthority,
reserveCollateralSupply(w), obligation(w), obligationOwner(s),
pythOracle, switchboardOracle, userTransferAuthority(s), tokenProgram;
the entry itself is kept minimal for backward compatibility.
Instructions the strategy builds directly against the program id,
without going through the 'instructions' name registry, are
documented under 'directInstructions' below (InitObligation and the
two refresh instructions); the registry keys are frozen for backward
compatibility.
'enable_collateral' and 'disable_collateral' are NOT Solend
instructions (deposited liquidity is always active obligation
collateral); they are kept only as unsupported placeholders for
backward compatibility.

withdraw.name: withdraw
docs: WithdrawObligationCollateralAndRedeemReserveCollateral

borrow.name: borrow
docs: BorrowObligationLiquidity

repay.name: repay
docs: RepayObligationLiquidity

enable_collateral.name: enable_collateral
docs: Not a Solend instruction: deposited liquidity is always active
obligation collateral. Unsupported placeholder.

disable_collateral.name: disable_collateral
docs: Not a Solend instruction: deposited liquidity is always active
obligation collateral. Unsupported placeholder.

liquidate.name: liquidate
docs: LiquidateObligation. Documented for completeness; not built by
the Solend strategy.
Instructions the Solend strategy encodes and submits directly
against the program id instead of through the 'instructions' name
registry above (they carry no arguments beyond their
discriminant). They are documented here so the account layouts
live next to the ones of the registry instructions; the loader
(SolanaProgram / find_idl_instruction) only reads 'instructions'.

init_obligation.name: init_obligation
docs: InitObligation. Initializes the obligation state in the
account created by the SystemProgram CreateAccountWithSeed
that immediately precedes it (base = obligation owner, seed =
the first 32 characters of the lending market's base58
address, space = 1300, lamports = the rent-exempt minimum,
owner = this program); that creation is a system-program
instruction and therefore not described here.
Required once per (owner, lending market) before the first
deposit: every other obligation instruction unpacks this
account and fails when it does not exist.

refresh_reserve.name: refresh_reserve
docs: RefreshReserve. Accrues a reserve's interest and re-reads its
oracle prices; required in the same transaction as any
instruction touching the reserve.

refresh_obligation.name: refresh_obligation
docs: RefreshObligation. Recomputes the obligation's collateral and
borrow values from its (already refreshed) reserves.
The account list is variadic: the obligation is followed by
every deposit reserve and then every borrow reserve, in the
exact order they are stored in the obligation account.
